items.description: Cursor 让我第一次强烈感受到 AI 编程的震撼，Codex 则让我第一次真正感觉到，AI 不只是编程助手，而是一个真正的超级Agent，Codex 明显更接近下一阶段的形态。
items.summary_zh: 这是一篇掘金文章，作者记录了自己从 Cursor 切换到 Codex、持续使用大半个月后的真实体验。在他看来，Cursor 让他第一次强烈感受到 AI 编程的价值，而 Codex 更像一个能自主完成任务的超级 Agent，而不只是编程助手，形态更接近下一阶段。适合正在做 AI 编程工具选型的开发者。
items.summary_en: A Juejin post by a developer who switched from Cursor to Codex and has used it for roughly half a month. Cursor, the author says, was his first strong taste of what AI coding can do, while Codex feels less like a coding assistant and more like an autonomous super-agent, closer to the next stage of tooling. Useful for developers weighing which AI coding tool to adopt.

items.title: Spring 近期新闻：Boot、Framework、Data、Security 和 Integration 的第二个里程碑版本
items.summary_zh: Spring 多个子项目发布第二个里程碑版本：Boot 4.2.0-M2 新增 management.observations.conventions 属性，可在 Micrometer 与 OpenTelemetry 之间切换语义约定，并支持用 LdapContextSource 自动配置命名 SSL Bundle；Data 2026.1.0-M2 初步兼容 Hibernate ORM 8.0.0.Beta1，为 Jakarta Persistence 4.0 做准备；Cloud 2026.0.0-M1（代号 Paddington）新增 PropertyPathNotifier 接口，Framework 7.1.0-M2 与 Security 7.2.0-M2 同步更新。关注 Spring 生态升级路径的后端开发者可据此评估迁移成本。
items.summary_en: Spring shipped second milestone releases across its projects. Spring Boot 4.2.0-M2 adds a management.observations.conventions property for switching between Micrometer and OpenTelemetry semantic conventions, and can auto-configure named SSL bundles from an LdapContextSource instance; Spring Data 2026.1.0-M2 adds preliminary Hibernate ORM 8.0.0.Beta1 support ahead of Jakarta Persistence 4.0, while Spring Cloud 2026.0.0-M1 (Paddington) introduces a PropertyPathNotifier interface. Spring Framework and Security M2 builds shipped alongside, so teams planning upgrades should check the release notes.

items.title: [分享创造] [送终身 500 个] 大家好，分享一个自己开发的开源工具： YourKeep。
items.summary_zh: YourKeep 是一款开源备份工具，文件在本地加密后拆成多份，可分存于不同云盘或硬盘，例如 2/3 方案任意保留 2 份即可恢复，无需注册、不上传服务器，恢复功能永久免费。目前已支持 iOS、Android、Windows、macOS 和 Linux，作者在 V2EX 通过 Apple 官方兑换链接发放 iOS 终身会员。适合担心云盘封号或硬盘损坏导致重要文件丢失的用户。
items.summary_en: YourKeep is an open-source backup tool that encrypts files locally, splits them into shards kept across different cloud drives or disks, and needs only a subset to restore the originals — for example, any 2 of 3 shards. It requires no account and no upload to a server, with recovery free forever, and runs on iOS, Android, Windows, macOS and Linux. The developer is giving away iOS lifetime codes through Apple's official redemption link on V2EX.

items.title: [硬件] 英伟达自己的光模块文档里写着：链路故障 80% 是光接口脏了
items.summary_zh: 英伟达 400G 光模块 MMS1X00-NS400 的规格文档在「Handling and Cleaning」一节写明：80% 的光模块链路故障与光接头脏污有关。该模块是 QSFP112 封装、单模 1310nm、最远 500 米，配 ConnectX-7 与 BlueField-3 使用，文档要求插纤前清洁端面和光纤接头并保留防尘帽。作者据此整理了先查端面、再交叉换位、最后才怀疑模块的排查顺序，适合机房运维和光模块使用者参考。
items.summary_en: NVIDIA's spec sheet for its 400G optical module MMS1X00-NS400 states in the Handling and Cleaning section that 80% of transceiver link problems come from dirty optical connectors. The QSFP112 module runs 4x100G-PAM4 over single-mode 1310nm fiber up to 500m and pairs with ConnectX-7 and BlueField-3; the doc requires cleaning both the module port and the fiber end face before mating and keeping dust caps on. The author adds a field checklist that starts with inspecting end faces instead of swapping modules, noting that a dirty core on one of the MPO-12/APC fibers is enough to degrade a lane.

items.title: 面试官问你：“AI 能写 80% 的代码了，公司为什么还需要你？”
items.description: 先说一个事实：2026 年的技术面试，已经和两年前完全不一样了。两年前面试问的是："手写一个 Promise"、"说说 React Fiber 原理"...现在面试官默认你会用 AI。他们真正想知道的
items.summary_zh: 这篇掘金文章讨论 2026 年技术面试的变化：两年前还在考手写 Promise、React Fiber 原理，如今面试官默认候选人会用 AI，转而追问「AI 能写 80% 的代码，公司为什么还需要你」。文章要回答的正是开发者该展示哪些 AI 替代不了的判断力和工程能力，适合正在准备面试的工程师。
items.summary_en: A Juejin post on how 2026 technical interviews differ from two years ago: instead of hand-writing a Promise or explaining React Fiber, interviewers now assume candidates already use AI and ask why a company should still hire them when AI writes 80% of the code. It's aimed at engineers preparing for interviews who need to articulate what AI can't replace.

items.title: [推广] Kling 4.0 局部编辑怎么验收：先分清客户要保留与修改的内容
items.summary_zh: Kling 4.0 局部编辑怎么验收：作者用六个问题把流程拆成创意编辑、商品核查与交付验收，建议先把客户需求写成「要改 / 必须保留 / 可适配」三栏再下指令。官方称编辑任务最多支持 5 段视频（含 1 段主视频）、累计不超 30 秒，9 月 30 日公告表示完整 4.0 计划 2026 年 10 月扩大开放。适合用 AI 换背景、换商品，又担心主体和商品细节被连带改坏的创作者。
items.summary_en: A practical guide to validating Kling 4.0's local edits: the author turns the workflow into six questions spanning creative editing, product fact-checking against real reference shots, and delivery review, and suggests writing requests as three columns — what to change, what to keep, what may adapt. Kling's docs say an edit task supports up to 5 videos including one main clip, totaling 30 seconds, and a Sept 30 notice says full 4.0 is planned to widen access in October 2026. Aimed at creators doing AI background or product swaps who still need to check subject edges, motion and label accuracy.

items.title: [iOS] Find My 查找 APP 里的 AirTag 全部消失不见了
items.summary_zh: 用户反映 Find My「物品」里的 AirTag 全部消失，而设备栏中的 iPhone、iPad、Mac 仍能正常显示。系统为 iOS 27.01，重启手机无效，用 iPad Pro（iPadOS 26）查看也是同样情况；作者还提到近半年遇到两次严重的苹果软件故障，上一次是 macOS 钥匙串被锁死。
items.summary_en: A user reports that every AirTag disappeared from the Items tab in Find My, while the iPhone, iPad and Mac still show up normally under Devices. Rebooting on iOS 27.01 doesn't help, and the same thing happens when checking from an iPad Pro running iPadOS 26. The poster says this is the second severe Apple software failure they've hit in under six months, the previous one being a locked macOS keychain.

items.title: [推广] 憋了一年， Kling 4.0 终于发布，但 AI 视频最该解决的，是不是“别让我重新抽一遍”？
items.summary_zh: Kling 4.0 已由官方在 X 宣布全面开放，新增创作界面并提到 MCP 与 CLI 接入，企业及开发者 API、10-bit HDR 输出仍属 Coming Soon。发帖人更在意 AI 视频能否“改稿”：调整运镜时修改是否收敛、满意部分能否保住、设置能否复用，这比单次生成价格更影响它能否进入固定工作流。
items.summary_en: Kling AI has announced on X that Kling 4.0 is fully open, adding a new creation interface and mentioning MCP and CLI access, while the enterprise/developer API and 10-bit HDR output remain Coming Soon. The poster isn't focused on image quality but on whether AI video can be revised: when you slow a camera move, do edits converge, do the parts you liked survive, and can settings be reused? For anyone shipping AI video, that reproducibility matters more than per-generation price.

Hong Kong/Macau data may have stayed in Hong Kong, though that part is only a guess.

items.title: 从 Harness 到 Loop：Agent 如何走向可靠交付与持续进化？
items.summary_zh: InfoQ 将一场直播整理成文：蚂蚁集团郭春晓主持，与蚂蚁 Harness 架构组肖汉松、腾讯任磊达、京东曲奎林讨论 Agent 从 Harness 到 Loop 的演进——前者解决“任务怎么完成”，后者解决“怎么越变越强”。核心观点是模型能力正被商品化、工程体系决定交付下限，执行可自动化但决策与验收仍需人拍板；QCon 上海站（10 月 22-24 日）设有【Loop Engineering】专题。
items.summary_en: An InfoQ write-up of a livestream features Ant Group's Guo Chunxiao hosting Xiao Hansong from Ant's Harness architecture team, Tencent's Ren Leida and JD's Qu Kuilin on the shift from Harness to Loop: Harness handles how an agent completes a task, while Loop handles how it keeps getting stronger. Their main points are that model capability is being commoditized, engineering systems set the delivery floor, and execution can be automated while decisions and acceptance still need humans. QCon Shanghai (Oct 22-24) has a Loop Engineering track.

items.title: 成立不到半年融资数亿元，98年清华学者、KAN一作创业：让AI学会设计模型
items.summary_zh: AI 创业公司元环智能（MetaCircle）成立不到半年，累计完成数亿元种子轮与种子+轮融资，创始人刘子鸣是 KAN 一作、现任清华大学人工智能学院助理教授。其研究对象是“元模型”，不直接执行任务，而是学习架构与训练配置同实验表现的关联，在训练完成前预测损失曲线，用于提前筛掉差方案乃至自动设计模型架构。
items.summary_en: MetaCircle, an AI startup founded in May 2026, has raised several hundred million yuan across seed and seed+ rounds led by Shunwei Capital, with 360's investment arm and Baidu Ventures among the backers. Founder Liu Ziming, born in 1998, is a Tsinghua assistant professor and first author of the KAN paper. The company is building a 'meta model' that learns how architectures and training configurations map to experimental results, predicting training curves before a run finishes so weak candidates can be dropped or architectures designed automatically.

items.title: 算力效率的边界：以体系结构量化与分布式工程破局 AI Infra
items.summary_zh: QCon 上海站（10 月 22-24 日）设立《AI Infra：算力效率决定规模化落地》专场，议题覆盖数据工程、集群调度与推理闭环。文章指出 2026 年成本重心正从预训练转向推理端，MoE 动态路由、长上下文显存占用与推理模型的 Token 消耗共同推高单任务成本，竞争指标已从单 Token 标价转向端到端任务的有效交付成本，适合做推理优化的 Infra 开发者。
items.summary_en: QCon Shanghai (Oct 22-24) hosts a track titled 'AI Infra: Compute Efficiency Decides Scalable Deployment,' spanning data engineering, cluster scheduling and the inference loop. The article argues that in 2026 cost is shifting from pretraining to inference: MoE dynamic routing, long-context memory residency and reasoning models burning thousands of tokens per request all inflate per-task spend, so the metric that matters is no longer per-token price but end-to-end cost per delivered task. Aimed at infra engineers working on inference optimization.

items.title: 从 App 到 Agent：字节跳动 Supabase 的 Agent-Native 规模化实践｜QCon上海
items.summary_zh: QCon 上海站（10 月 22-24 日）上，字节跳动资深技术专家张国强将分享 Supabase 从 App Backend 转向 Agent Backend 的演进实践。面向 App，用 Serverless、Data as Git 和前端自动部署支撑应用快速生成；面向 Agent，则通过 AI Gateway、Sandbox、记忆库和知识库搭建安全可治理的运行底座，并结合豆包应用生成与 TRAE 编程实践复盘工程取舍。
items.summary_en: At QCon Shanghai, ByteDance senior engineer Zhang Guoqiang will present how ByteDance's Supabase evolved from an App backend into an Agent-Native one. For apps it relies on Serverless, Data as Git and automatic frontend deployment to accelerate app generation; for agents it adds an AI Gateway, Sandbox, memory store and knowledge base as a secure, governable runtime. The talk draws on Doubao app generation and TRAE coding practice to review the key trade-offs.

items.title: 亚马逊云科技推出 CloudWatch Omni：不仅监控系统，还要评估 AI 是否靠谱
items.summary_zh: 亚马逊云科技发布 Amazon CloudWatch Omni，一个 AI 优先的可观测性平台：除传统延迟、错误等指标外，它还捕获智能体端到端追踪，评估正确性、连贯性、检索效果与工具选择，并支持用生产流量构建测试集、比较提示词和检测回归。它兼容 LangChain、CrewAI、OpenAI SDK、Strands 等框架，原生支持 OpenTelemetry，并同时提供 SSO Web 控制台和免费的 VS Code/Kiro IDE 扩展。
items.summary_en: Amazon Web Services launched CloudWatch Omni, an AI-first observability platform that goes beyond standard metrics to capture end-to-end agent traces and assess correctness, coherence, retrieval quality and tool selection, letting teams build test datasets from production traffic and catch regressions. It supports frameworks including LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI SDK and Strands, is built on open standards such as OpenTelemetry, and ships both an SSO web console and a free VS Code/Kiro extension.

items.title: Istio 1.31 拥抱 AI 智能体，却先宣布“告别”Google Cloud

Replacing gostatsd sidecars with a Collector distribution and folding metrics into the tracing sidecar cut sidecar resource use across the fleet by about 30%.

items.title: NationalSecurityAgency/ghidra
items.description: Ghidra is a software reverse engineering (SRE) framework
items.author: NationalSecurityAgency
items.summary_zh: Ghidra 由美国国家安全局（NSA）研究部门开发并维护，是一套软件逆向工程框架，提供反汇编、反编译、图形化与脚本等功能，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux 及多种处理器指令集，可交互或自动化运行。用户能用 Java 或 Python 编写扩展，适合分析恶意代码或做大规模逆向工程的团队。
items.summary_en: Ghidra is a software reverse engineering framework built and maintained by the National Security Agency's Research Directorate. It bundles disassembly, decompilation, graphing and scripting for Windows, macOS and Linux binaries across many processor instruction sets, and runs both interactively and in automated mode. Users can extend it with Java or Python, making it a customizable platform for malware analysis and large-team SRE work.

The README claims 250,000+ scientists already use it, so it targets researchers who want a general-purpose agent to handle data processing or literature analysis.

items.summary_en: ECC is a performance optimization system for AI coding agent harnesses, adding skills, instincts, memory, security and research-first development on top of tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Opencode and Cursor. It treats an agent's runtime as a tunable operating system, which makes it relevant to developers who already lean on coding agents daily and want more stable, controllable behavior.

items.summary_en: Context Mode is an optimization layer for AI coding agents that sandboxes tool output, which it says cuts context usage by 98%, persists session memory, and enforces routing across 17 platforms via MCP plus hooks. It ships as an npm package under the ELv2 license, aimed at developers whose agents keep blowing through their context window.

items.title: xerj-org/xerj

items.summary_en: XERJ is a Rust-based search tool that gives AI agents a single command to index code, docs, logs and PDFs, so they can query your data directly instead of burning tokens on grep and sed. It ships under Apache-2.0 and is aimed at developers who want coding agents to find the right content in large repos and document sets.
